appConfig.name: Financial Reconciliation System
appConfig.description: Financial reconciliation on GeniSpace: automated matching of cash book and bank statements with variance analysis.

steps.title: Step 1: Select baseline
steps.description: Choose a baseline from the list (cash book or bank statement), or preview baseline data.

datasource-selector.title: Select baseline
datasource-selector.description: Pick the baseline data source (cash book or bank statement). Typically use the cash book as the baseline and compare to the bank statement.

steps.title: Step 2: Upload file
steps.description: Upload the file to reconcile against the baseline (Excel or PDF). If the baseline is the cash book, upload the bank statement; if the baseline is the bank statement, upload the cash book.

transactionDateField.title: Transaction date column
transactionDateField.description: Column for transaction date in the upload

amountField.title: Amount column
amountField.description: Column for amount in the upload

counterpartyField.title: Counterparty column
counterpartyField.description: Column for counterparty name in the upload

summaryField.title: Memo column
summaryField.description: Column for memo in the upload

dateTolerance.title: Date tolerance (days)
dateTolerance.description: Allowed date variance in days; default 3.

steps.title: Step 5: Run reconciliation
steps.description: Run matching and view live progress and results.

steps.title: Step 6: View results
steps.description: Review reconciliation results, variances, and unmatched lines.
